summary: End-to-end verification of Payroll Phase 2 (CEO Approval queue in Operations → Approvals → HR) and Phase 3 (Cashbook Add Expense → Payroll picker flips payslip to paid). Backend pytest suite: 7/7 passing. Frontend Playwright: HR Approvals reject+approve flow verified (toast fires, rows disappear, count badge updates). Cashbook Add Expense → Overhead → Payroll sub-cat surfaces the payroll-payslip-picker with 5 approved-unpaid payslips; selecting one auto-fills Total Amount (locked), pre-fills To (party) with employee_name, and shows 'Net salary locked at ₹X. Saving this expense will mark the payslip as PAID.' subtext.
critical_code_review_comments: CashbookSplit.js (line 109): isPayrollMode is gated on `payablePayslips.length > 0 || selectedPayslip`. When user picks the 'Payroll' sub-category but the payable list comes back empty (e.g. all payslips already paid), the picker block never renders, so the helpful empty-state message ('No payslips are currently CEO-approved & unpaid…') becomes unreachable. Consider tracking a separate `isPayrollCategory` flag based purely on the sub-category name so the empty state is visible to the user.

payroll_routes.py reject endpoint (line 526) accepts ReviewPayslipRequest but does not require review_text to be non-empty server-side. Frontend gates this via the disabled Confirm button, but a direct API call could submit an empty rejection. Low priority — consider enforcing min length on review_text for audit hygiene.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (HR approvals reject+approve + Cashbook payroll picker all verified)

seed_data_creation: Created an Expense Split sub-category named 'Payroll' under top category 'Overhead' (category_id=esc_d21473b90d, percent=50) via POST /api/finance/expense-split/categories — required for the Cashbook Payroll picker to activate. Also seeded ₹X cash credit via /api/finance/banks/cashbook/entries (kind=credit, gst_type=non_gst) inside test_cashbook_expense_with_payslip_flips_to_paid to satisfy the balance check.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 2 endpoints (/api/payroll/approvals, /payslip/{id}/approve, /payslip/{id}/reject) and Phase 3 endpoint (POST /api/finance/banks/cashbook/expense with payslip_id) are fully working. Auth uses session_token (not 'token') from POST /api/auth/login — see test fixture. The HR bucket inside /approvals correctly shows the payroll-approvals-section and badge count includes payroll approvals. CashbookSplit pulls payable payslips when the picked sub-category name equals 'payroll' (case-insensitive, exact match) — make sure a sub-cat literally named 'Payroll' exists (already created as esc_d21473b90d).
rca of the issue: N/A — no regressions found. Both phases function as specified in the request.
